pipeline.title: Syndax shares fall 17% after calling it quits on Niktimvo fibrosis program
pipeline.summary: Syndax and Incyte are cutting their idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis program short after a phase 2 trial failed to meet its primary endpoint. The drugmakers plan to refocus on expanding the study drug Niktimvo's label for its original indication, graft-versus-host disease.

pipeline.title: BioNTech’s mRNA cancer vaccine fails phase 3 test, significantly denting analysts’ confidence
pipeline.summary: A phase 2/3 clinical trial of BioNTech’s mRNA cancer immunotherapy BNT113 has missed one of its dual primary endpoints. But with immature overall survival data offering a path to redemption, the German biotech is continuing to track patients in the metastatic head and neck cancer

pipeline.title: Mirum on its way to 3rd rare liver indication for Livmarli
pipeline.summary: Livmarli significantly improved severe itching caused by rare liver diseases. With the phase 3 win in hand, Mirum is looking for a third indication from the FDA early next year.

pipeline.title: Roche sets sights on FDA approval decision of July 2027 with updated eye drug data
pipeline.summary: One year on from a mixed phase 3 readout, Roche has shared updated data from eye disease trials that could support FDA approval by July.

pipeline.title: Tortugas’ schizophrenia drug proves worth in phase 2 Hansoh trial in China
pipeline.summary: Tortugas Neuroscience’s schizophrenia drug from Hansoh Pharma has proven its worth in a phase 2b study, validating the fledgling biotech’s neurology strategy.

pipeline.title: BMS doubles up with pivotal wins in lung disease, solid tumor that offer hope for post-patent cliff growth
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has reported phase 3 wins in a lung disease and a solid tumor, taking two steps on its path toward post-patent cliff growth.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Vir looks to Liu to lead late-stage push
pipeline.summary: As Vir pushes its lead hepatitis D combo through phase 3 development, the biotech has tapped an experienced medical expert to light the way. David Liu, M.D., Ph.D., is now Vir’s chief medical officer, after most recently serving in the same role at Nuvation Bio.

pipeline.title: Endeavor’s threat to IPF incumbents increases after phase 2 win for Hedgehog inhibitor
pipeline.summary: Endeavor BioMedicines solidified its potential threat to Big Pharma with a phase 2b readout suggesting its Hedgehog inhibitor could become the first drug to reduce lung fibrosis while increasing total lung capacity.

pipeline.title: Ono pays $80M for regional rights to trio of Biohaven IgG degraders, including phase 3 Grave’s asset
pipeline.summary: Japan’s Ono Pharmaceutical is paying $80 million upfront for the regional rights to a trio of Biohaven’s IgG degraders, led by a phase 3-stage Grave’s disease prospect.

pipeline.title: Zealand, Roche’s ‘intriguing’ weight loss for amylin drug soured by blood sugar data
pipeline.summary: Zealand Pharma has reported more phase 2 data on its Roche-partnered amylin analog, linking the drug candidate to competitive weight loss but a lackluster effect on blood sugar.

pipeline.title: Argenx digests phase 2 celiac win for $2.2B drug, preps pivotal run
pipeline.summary: A phase 2 celiac disease trial of argenx’s FB102 has hit its primary endpoint, delivering a boost to a drug candidate that the biotech acquired in its $2.2 billion takeover of Forte Biosciences.

pipeline.title: iRegene Therapeutics’s NouvSight001 Cleared for Clinical Trials in the U.S. and China for Retinitis Pigmentosa
pipeline.summary: Following its Parkinson’s disease program, iRegene advances another off-the-shelf cell therapy into clinical development in the U.S. and China.

pipeline.title: Decreasing process variability in fluid management systems
pipeline.summary: Discover why flow paths, tubing and connectors may limit your bioprocess performance

pipeline.title: Another Paragon spinout goes public through reverse merger
pipeline.summary: One lawyer involved noted how it's yet another example of Paragon and key investor Fairmount — which have helped transform the reputation for reverse mergers — quickly executing on a complicated deal.

pipeline.title: BioNTech mRNA cancer immunotherapy misses first objective in key study
pipeline.summary: An early data check showed the shot didn’t delay tumor progression in a form of head and neck cancer, though BioNTech is holding out hope it might eventually extend survival.

pipeline.title: Roche extends China deal streak with $1B pact for RNAi obesity drug
